changelog:
Initial release of gemini-android.

- Provides a summary of Gemini AI integration on Android devices.
- Features include system-level AI integration, cross-app task automation, generative widgets, upgraded input method (Rambler), and privacy protections.
- Fast commands table and supported device list included.
- FAQ and usage guides available for key functions.
summary: Gemini Intelligence 安卓 AI 能力汇总 - 系统级 AI 集成、任务自动化、生成式界面、输入法升级等。
